description: Add or overwrite MANY keyframes across MANY layers in ONE call — functionally equivalent to N add_keyframe calls but with one HTTP/MCP round-trip. Pass an array of entries; each entry has the same fields as add_keyframe. Validated atomically: any invalid entry rejects the whole batch. Use this whenever you'd call add_keyframe more than a couple of times (rippling grids, twinkling starfields, staggered text reveals).

keyframes.description: One or more keyframe entries to apply.

easing.description: Interpolation to the next keyframe. Default linear.

elementId.description: Layer id (video.<id>, image.<id>, shapes.<id>, text.<id>, or group.<id>).

projectId.description: Opaque project id (a v4 UUID, from list_projects/create_project). Selects which existing project this call mutates.

name: set_keyframes_batch

outputSchema.description: The result envelope every Morpha tool returns.

data.description: The payload, shaped by the tool.

editorUrl.description: Opens this project in the editor.

note.description: What to do next when not ready.

status.description: For cache-backed readers: whether the answer was ready.
